Name: MissCoriel's Supplement Pack 1
Author: MissCoriel
Description:
This is the first supplemental Pack I made to work both Alone or along with my main mod.  

[b][size=4][color=#00ff00]Listen to the pack![/color]
[/size][/b][size=2][soundcloud]https://soundcloud.com/evilpickle-music-dept/sets/supplement-pack-i[/soundcloud][/size]

There are 3 new songs that randomly play in the caves depending on which level you on and one song that will play in all of them!
The theme commonly used for Penny has been replaced by the same theme but handcrafted by me.
[size=5]Visit my [/size][url=https://discord.gg/uSGNKNf]Cozy Apartment[/url][size=5] if you have questions or interests.[/size]
[size=3]Have the desire to support me and my endeavors?
[url=https://www.patreon.com/MissCoriel]Support me through Patreon[/url]
My promise to you:  My mods will always be free and open.  Patreon will give you special Discord roles on my server and Exclusive access to my original music.  
You do not need to ever pay money to access my mods/content or beta releases![/size]
